title: Beyond Caption-Based Queries in Video Moment Retrieval

problems.name: Multi-Moment, Compositional, and Complex Query Grounding

problems.name: Domain Shift and Generalization
problems.evidence_sentence: Our analysis reveals two key generalization challenges: (i) A language gap, arising from the linguistic under-specification of search-queries, and (ii) a multi-moment gap, caused by the shift from single moment to multi-moment queries.

problems.name: Annotation Scarcity and Noisy Supervision
problems.evidence_sentence: This annotation process induces a visual bias, leading to overly descriptive and fine-grained queries, which significantly differ from the more general search queries that users are likely to employ in practice.

methods.name: Transformer/DETR-Style Proposal Decoding
methods.evidence_sentence: DETR [5] has become the cornerstone of most existing VMR methods [14, 24, 33, 44], thanks to its usage of K learnable decoder queries, each of which maps to a potential retrieved moment with a corresponding confidence score.
